propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml duplicates test coverage already provided by matrix cells in _build-and-test.yml and consumes a concurrent job slot against a GitHub Free org-wide cap of 20 slots.
Deleting the import-linter job creates an unguarded gap where future edits (marker additions, file moves, path filters) could silently stop the two optionality test files from being collected.

A durable checked-in test must assert that tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py collect exactly 9 items under default suite selection (-m "not integration and not external").
The collection guard test must fail if any marker excluding either file from the default selection is added, catching regressions at commit time rather than through implicit assumptions.
